As requested, I am sending you the Acme Q1 market data information for your reference. Please find the summary below:

---
Acme Q1 Market Data Information Summary

1. Category Share - Protein Bars:
- January 2026: 18.4% (Nielsen scanner Q4-Q1 pull, share up 60bps QoQ — driven by club channel reset)
- February 2026: 18.6% (Nielsen scanner Feb pull, share holding — Verdant flat — see analyst note)
- March 2026: 18.9% (Nielsen scanner March pull, share continuing to grow — Verdant flat-to-down)

2. Retail Velocity - Protein Bar SKU:
- January 2026: 4.7 units/store/week (IRI scan, steady — top-3 SKU in category)
- February 2026: 4.9 units/store/week (IRI scan, uptick — Q1 promo driving trial)
- March 2026: 5.1 units/store/week (IRI scan, best Q1 reading — momentum continues)

3. Regional Momentum:
- Southeast: +12% YoY (Jan, Acme syndicated dashboard, strongest region — pull-through from Walmart reset)
- West: +8% YoY (Feb, Acme syndicated dashboard, below plan +12% — competitive pressure from private label)
- Northeast: +9% YoY (Mar, Acme syndicated dashboard, steady — no notable competitive shifts)

4. Promo Lift:
- MLK weekend reset (Jan): +22% (outperformed planned +15%)
- Super Bowl window (Feb): +18% (met plan)

5. Share of Voice - Digital:
- February 2026: 33% (Pathmatics digital ad scrape, leading category — Verdant at 24%)
- March 2026: 34% (Pathmatics digital ad scrape, steady leadership — recommend hold spend in Q2)
---

If you have any follow-up questions or need further details, feel free to let me know.

Best regards,
Daniel Park
Pinecrest Strategy Group
